parts.t: Welcome to an unbeatable lifestyle at Morgan Crossing, where everything you need is just steps away. This bright 2 bed, 2 bath home offers 1,010 sq. ft. of well-designed living space above shops, cafés, restaurants, and everyday conveniences, with quick access to Highway 99. The open-concept layout features stainless steel appliances, in-suite laundry, and generous storage, while a sprawling 409 sq. ft. patio/deck is perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Complete with two underground parking stalls and a storage locker, this home delivers walkable convenience, comfort, and space in one of South Surrey’s most vibrant communities.

v: Located in the heart of Morgan Crossing, close to shops, cafés, restaurants and everyday amenities in South Surrey.
Set in the desirable Grandview Surrey neighbourhood, known for walkability, convenience and strong buyer demand.
Bright 2 bed, 2 bath condo with 1,010 sq ft of well-designed living space in a highly sought-after South Surrey location.
Easy access to Grandview Corners, parks, schools, recreation and Highway 99 for convenient South Surrey living.

parts.t: 220 15735 Croydon Drive is located in the heart of Morgan Crossing, one of South Surrey’s most convenient and walkable communities. Buyers love this area for its mix of shops, cafés, restaurants, fitness options, and everyday services all within steps of home. Morgan Crossing continues to attract strong interest from buyers looking for condo living with an urban-style feel in South Surrey.

This home is set in the desirable Grandview Surrey neighbourhood, a popular choice for buyers who want modern homes, convenient amenities, and easy access to major commuter routes. Grandview Surrey is known for its strong community feel, excellent shopping, nearby parks, and close proximity to South Surrey’s top schools and services.

A big reason buyers search for 220 15735 Croydon Drive is the unbeatable location. From shopping and dining to parks, recreation, and quick access to Highway 99, this address offers a convenient South Surrey lifestyle. For buyers looking at Morgan Crossing condos for sale, this location stands out for walkability, comfort, and long-term appeal.

Condo buyers in South Surrey are often looking for a balance of space, convenience, and low-maintenance living. 220 15735 Croydon Drive offers the benefit of being in a vibrant, amenity-rich area close to Grandview Corners, Morgan Crossing, and everyday essentials. This is a great option for buyers searching for South Surrey condos in a highly walkable location.
